title: English Practice Quiz 0914
description: A ten-question English practice quiz covering grammar, vocabulary and practical communication.

questions.question: A consignment is ___.
options: a shipment of goods sent to someone
questions.explanation: a shipment of goods sent to someone is the correct choice based on the meaning and context of the question.

questions.question: A tracking number is used to ___.
options: monitor the progress of a shipment
questions.explanation: monitor the progress of a shipment is the correct choice based on the meaning and context of the question.

questions.question: Before dispatching a package, check ___.
questions.explanation: address, contents and required documentation is the correct choice based on the meaning and context of the question.

questions.question: A delivery delay should be communicated ___.
options: promptly with an updated estimate when available
questions.explanation: promptly with an updated estimate when available is the correct choice based on the meaning and context of the question.

questions.question: A fragile label indicates that a parcel ___.
questions.explanation: needs careful handling is the correct choice based on the meaning and context of the question.

questions.question: Proof of delivery confirms ___.
questions.explanation: that the shipment was received is the correct choice based on the meaning and context of the question.

questions.question: A route plan helps a driver ___.
options: organise the order of delivery stops
questions.explanation: organise the order of delivery stops is the correct choice based on the meaning and context of the question.

questions.question: A damaged package found before dispatch should be ___.
options: reported and handled according to procedure
questions.explanation: reported and handled according to procedure is the correct choice based on the meaning and context of the question.

questions.question: A delivery manifest usually lists ___.
questions.explanation: items or consignments being transported is the correct choice based on the meaning and context of the question.

questions.question: Accurate address information helps reduce ___.
questions.explanation: failed or misdirected deliveries is the correct choice based on the meaning and context of the question.
